decision_rule: smallest n in (243, 404, 650, 890) with edge_small recovery_rate >= 0.8 and null clean_rate >= 0.95; compare against the per-fit linear-scaled budget claim and against the row-43 full-corpus convention
motivation: 2026-08-15 external adversarial review: per-fit linear-scaled conservative budgets (~49-107) exclude the 96-parameter entry phase at most outer folds, and the 20-observations-per-parameter rule was never measured. Owner chose to measure.
question: What is the smallest chronological training-session count at which the real compact_shared_lifecycle entry phase (96 trainable parameters, exit head frozen) recovers a planted, architecture-representable entry edge at >=80% of trials while keeping >=95% of null-world trials at <=5% entry rate?
scope_limits: Phase A measures the ENTRY phase only; the 24-parameter exit head and trajectory-level ESS are Phase B.
Stateless per-minute action evaluation: measures representational recovery, not trading economics.
Synthetic worlds: a measured minimum here calibrates the capacity law; it does not by itself authorize any real fit.
Smoke runs before this declaration were timing-only; their metrics were discarded unread.
